Name: Ghost Horse
Author: lonelyluster
Description:
I like ghosts, and the regular horse was a bit vanilla, so I made it transparent, changed the colors, made the eyes light up, and made it leave behind trails of smoke. Yay ghost horse.

To install,
~ Backup your regular horse.xnb file (Steam/ steamapps/ common/ Stardew Valley/ Content/ Animals) just incase you decide you want to go back to the original
~ Replace it with mine in the 'Animals' folder
